claim_text: Whey is a milk-derived protein and is unsuitable for people with milk-protein allergy; lactose-free whey products may still contain milk proteins and are not automatically safe for allergy.
health_goal_or_outcome: Identify safety constraints and prevent unsupported supplement recommendations.

population.other_context: People with milk-protein allergy considering whey protein.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Supplement products; verify exact formulation, concentration and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS exercise/protein context plus product allergen labeling; exact product label is essential.
limitations: Do not equate lactose intolerance with milk allergy.
Exact source passages, product-specific labeling and clinical applicability require full appraisal.
